what: International seller reports cancelling seven US-bound orders at the end of August because they had no solution for new US tariff/duty requirements, noting four customers asked to reserve their items.
verbatim_snippet: "At the end of August, I had to cancel 7 orders to the USA because I wasn't yet set up with a proper solution for handling the new US tariff/duty requirements. It was a really difficult decision, but I didn't want to risk non-compliance or surprise charges for my customers. Thankfully, 4 of those customers asked me to reserve their items and were very understanding."
